description.p: This page documents the visible properties returned by properties for a bubblelegend graphics object.

tr.td: Nelson computes this value; graphics operations update it.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'off', 'on'.
updates rendered output on the next graphics refresh.
Type: on/off value. Supported values: 'on', 'off', true, or false.
changes the order used for bubble size labels in the bubble legend.
Type: text keyword. Supported values: 'ascending' or 'descending'.
controls whether an interrupting callback is queued or canceled.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'queue', 'cancel'.
runs when the object receives a mouse-button event.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, character vector, string scalar, or callback cell array.
parenting operations update the vector.
Type: graphics object handle vector. Supported values: empty vector or child handles.
updates rendered output on the next graphics refresh.

Type: color value. Supported values: 'red'/'r', 'green'/'g', 'blue'/'b', 'cyan'/'c', 'magenta'/'m', 'yellow'/'y', 'black'/'k', 'white'/'w', RGB triplet [r g b] with values in [0,1], or hexadecimal color '#RRGGBB'/'#RGB'.
attaches the menu used for context-click actions.
Type: graphics object handle scalar. Supported values: [] or a uicontextmenu handle.
runs when the object is created.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, character vector, string scalar, or callback cell array.
runs when the object is deleted.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, character vector, string scalar, or callback cell array.
updates rendered output on the next graphics refresh.

Type: color value or color mode keyword. Supported values: 'red'/'r', 'green'/'g', 'blue'/'b', 'cyan'/'c', 'magenta'/'m', 'yellow'/'y', 'black'/'k', 'white'/'w', RGB triplet [r g b] with values in [0,1], or hexadecimal color '#RRGGBB'/'#RGB', 'none', 'flat', 'interp'.
updates rendered output on the next graphics refresh.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'normal', 'italic'.
updates rendered output on the next graphics refresh.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: a system font name or 'FixedWidth'.
recomputes geometry, limits, or layout.
Type: finite numeric scalar. Supported values: finite scalar value.
updates rendered output on the next graphics refresh.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'normal', 'bold'.
controls whether handle-search functions can find the object.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off', 'callback'.
includes or excludes the object from mouse hit testing.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
updates rendered output on the next graphics refresh.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'tex', 'none'.
controls whether a running callback can be interrupted.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
updates the object placement requested from the parent layout manager.
Type: layout options object or empty value. Supported values: layout information stored by parent layout managers, including tile placement data where the object supports tiled layouts.
updates the minimum and maximum labels displayed by the bubble legend.
Type: text value, string array, or cell array of character row vectors. Supported values: two labels, or empty value for automatic labels.
updates rendered output on the next graphics refresh.
Type: finite numeric scalar. Supported values: value greater than or equal to 0.
recomputes geometry, limits, or layout.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'north', 'south', 'east', 'west', 'northoutside', 'southoutside', 'eastoutside', 'westoutside', 'best', 'none', 'layout', 'manual'.
changes the number of reference bubbles displayed in the bubble legend.
Type: positive integer scalar. Supported values: finite integer greater than or equal to 1.
reparents the object and updates Children on the old and new parents.
Type: graphics object handle scalar. Supported values: a valid parent handle for the object class.
selects which visible or invisible parts can receive mouse hits.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'visible', 'all', 'none'.
recomputes geometry, limits, or layout.
Type: finite numeric vector. Supported values: finite vector with the documented size, such as [left bottom width height], [x y z], [azimuth elevation], or [minor major].
updates rendered output on the next graphics refresh.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
updates rendered output on the next graphics refresh.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
updates rendered output on the next graphics refresh.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: style names defined by this object, such as UI styles, light styles, chart styles, or line styles.
updates the stored object state.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: empty text or an object identifier.
updates rendered output on the next graphics refresh.

Type: color value. Supported values: 'red'/'r', 'green'/'g', 'blue'/'b', 'cyan'/'c', 'magenta'/'m', 'yellow'/'y', 'black'/'k', 'white'/'w', RGB triplet [r g b] with values in [0,1], or hexadecimal color '#RRGGBB'/'#RGB'.
updates the displayed title or the title object associated with the graphics item.
Type: text graphics object or text value, depending on the object class. Supported values: a title text object, character row vector, string scalar, or empty text.
Nelson computes this value; graphics operations update it.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: read-only object type name, for example 'figure', 'axes', 'line', or 'scatter'.
recomputes geometry, limits, or layout.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'pixels', 'normalized', 'inches', 'centimeters', 'points', 'characters', 'data'.
updates the stored object state.
Type: Nelson array. Supported values: any Nelson value, including [], numeric arrays, text, cells, structures, or handles.
updates rendered output on the next graphics refresh.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
